steps: Reset only after the scheduled service has actually been done.
With the car parked and switched on, tap Setup on the touchscreen.
Go to Vehicle, then Cluster, then Service Interval, and choose Reset.
Switch off and on again and check that the Service in message no longer appears.
oil.note: Checked in the 2023 EV6 owner's manual. The EV6 has no engine oil; this reminder counts down to scheduled maintenance by miles and days.
